_doc: Vet shim registry for harness/check.py. Keys are --shim names; entries
give the subprocess argv ('command') and its working directory ('cwd'),
resolved relative to the lm15-contract root. Every command must speak
the JSONL protocol in harness/PROTOCOL.md on stdin/stdout and never
touch the network (the harness wraps it in `unshare -rn` when available).
To add a language, add an entry here once its shim exists, e.g.:
Keys starting with '_' are ignored by the harness.
